title: 838. Magic Squares In Grid

examples.explanation: Only the top-left 3x3 window is magic.

hints: The centre of any 3x3 magic square using 1..9 must be 5; skip windows whose centre differs.
Check distinctness of 1..9 first with a boolean set, then verify the eight line sums equal 15.
Slide the window over all (rows-2) * (cols-2) positions.
